heroSubheadline: Bring us your idea, business problem or use case—even if the details are still taking shape. We help clarify the requirement, assess where AI adds value and build a practical solution in agreed stages, from an initial prototype to an MVP or scoped application.
capabilitiesLead: Start with the use case. We help define a feasible approach and develop a solution around your goals, available data and agreed scope.

capabilities.title: Use-Case Discovery & Feasibility
capabilities.description: Turn an idea or loosely defined requirement into a clear starting point. We assess the intended users, desired outcome, available data and key constraints, then recommend an approach and scope for the next stage.

capabilities.title: Custom Solution Development
capabilities.description: Build a prototype, MVP or application around your use case. We develop in agreed stages, demonstrate progress and refine the solution with your feedback. Features, integrations and deployment responsibilities are defined for each engagement.

capabilities.title: GenAI & Knowledge Solutions
capabilities.description: Help users find information, summarize documents, extract key details and prepare drafts from selected sources. We shape document assistants and knowledge solutions around your use case, using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) where appropriate.

capabilities.title: AI Agents & Workflow Automation
capabilities.description: Explore and prototype AI agents for defined tasks and workflows, with human review at agreed steps. Scope and integrations are assessed for each use case.

examplesHeading: What We Can Help You Build
examplesIntro: Illustrative use cases. The approach and delivery scope are assessed for each project.

examples.title: Product prototypes and MVPs
examples.description: Turn an idea into a prototype to explore the experience, or a scoped MVP for initial use and feedback.

examples.title: Document and knowledge assistants
examples.description: Find information, summarize documents and prepare drafts from selected sources.

examples.title: Custom business applications
examples.description: Support a defined process with tailored screens, data handling and relevant integrations.

examples.title: Agent workflow prototypes
examples.description: Explore how an agent could perform a specific task, with human review at agreed points.

examplesTechNote: We select the approach and technology after reviewing your use case, available data, constraints and budget.
processIntro: We agree on the outcome before building and use review points to keep the work aligned with your needs.

processStages.label: UNDERSTAND
processStages.title: Understand
processStages.description: Discuss the use case, intended users and desired outcome.

processStages.label: ASSESS & SCOPE
processStages.title: Assess & Scope
processStages.description: Review feasibility, data and access needs; agree deliverables and success criteria.

processStages.label: BUILD & DEMONSTRATE
processStages.title: Build & Demonstrate
processStages.description: Develop the agreed solution in stages and show progress.

processStages.label: REVIEW & REFINE
processStages.title: Review & Refine
processStages.description: Test against the agreed criteria, gather feedback and address issues.

processStages.label: HANDOVER & NEXT STEPS
processStages.title: Handover & Next Steps
processStages.description: Deliver the agreed outputs and discuss further development or support.

processCaption: Engagements may conclude with a feasibility assessment, prototype, MVP or scoped application, depending on your needs.
engagementLead: Start with an introductory conversation. If your use case needs substantial investigation, we can scope a paid discovery engagement. If the requirement is already clear, we can move directly to a scoped proposal.

engagementOptions.title: Discovery & Feasibility
engagementOptions.description: For ideas that need investigation before a build can be scoped. Receive a solution brief, recommended approach and proposed next steps. Technical assumptions that need practical testing can be explored through a separately scoped proof of concept.

engagementOptions.title: Prototype or Proof of Concept
engagementOptions.description: Explore the proposed experience through a prototype, or test a key technical assumption through a proof of concept. Receive an agreed demonstration, findings and recommendations for further development.

engagementOptions.title: Scoped Solution Development
engagementOptions.description: For requirements that are sufficiently clear to build. Develop an MVP or application with agreed features, review points and deliverables. Deployment and handover responsibilities are defined in the project scope.

whyUs.title: Start with your use case
whyUs.description: We help clarify the problem, intended users and desired outcome before recommending an approach.

whyUs.title: See progress as we build
whyUs.description: Review demonstrations at agreed checkpoints and provide feedback as the solution takes shape.

whyUs.title: Make informed next-step decisions
whyUs.description: Understand what has been built, its limitations and what further development would involve.

ctaHeading: Have a Use Case in Mind?
ctaText: Share your idea, business problem or workflow. We'll discuss what you want to achieve and the right starting point.
